n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (The Fracture gate is already collapsing when somebody steps backward through the evacuation tape with a phone held at arm’s length.)

n2.speaker: kess
n2.text: —and that, chat, is why we do not stand under a sky-tear just because the lighting is incredible.

n3.speaker: player
n3.text: (Fox ears. Orange-red hair. A scorched jacket. A ring light clipped to a backpack that has been repaired with three different colors of tape.)

n4.speaker: kess
n4.text: Okay. Hero shot. Look exhausted but not tragic.

n6.speaker: kess
n6.text: Oh, perfect. Boundaries. Love a professional.

n7.speaker: player
n7.text: (She flips the phone face-down before you can ask twice. The smile stays; the performance drops half a degree.)

n8.speaker: kess
n8.text: You’re the landlord with the elf Warden.

n10.speaker: kess
n10.text: I know three things before breakfast: gate clips, rent prices, and who in this city is willing to put Gatekin behind a door that locks.

n11.speaker: player
n11.text: That sounds less like streaming and more like stalking.

n13.speaker: player
n13.text: (A warning siren chirps behind the barricade. One last wave-creature claws out of the dying tear before the response team notices.)

n15.speaker: player
n15.text: (She moves first. Too fast. Ember flashes at her heels and she crosses the road in one reckless line.)

n17.speaker: player
n17.text: (The creature turns toward her. Your blade catches it from the side. Her second strike lands before the ash reaches the pavement.)

n18.speaker: kess
n18.text: See? Synergy. We’re already a brand.

n19.speaker: player
n19.text: You baited it with your face.

n21.speaker: player
n21.text: (The phone in her pocket vibrates. She checks it instantly. For one second the grin disappears.)

n24.speaker: player
n24.text: You looked at it like it had a pulse.

n25.speaker: kess
n25.text: And you look like somebody who owns empty square footage.

n26.speaker: kess
n26.text: Here’s the deal. I pay rent. I don’t complain about pipes unless they are actively on fire. I can promote the building if you want, not promote it if you don’t, and I’m out of your fur before you can regret the decision.

n30.speaker: kess
n30.text: Temporary enough that neither of us has to make it weird.

n31.speaker: player
n31.text: (That evening, she carries everything she owns upstairs in one trip because accepting a second trip would apparently be a moral failure.)

n34.speaker: kess
n34.text: Bedroom, studio, command center, revenue-generating asset.

n35.speaker: player
n35.text: (She puts the repaired ring light in the corner, checks the window latch twice, then sets her bag beside the bed without unpacking it.)

n37.speaker: player
n37.text: You don’t have to earn the room tonight.

n39.speaker: player
n39.text: (She smiles before you can ask what that means.)

n40.speaker: kess
n40.text: Anyway. Welcome to the content house.
